continuation_cursor.last_completed_action: Completed M8-001 at substantive commit fa370f6b4da674b300b08accf40cb70dd326ed4d: added a pure-Go Redundancy Budget Controller with fixed normal=1.0x, weak-1.5x=1.5x, weak-2x=2.0x and auto levels 1.0/1.25/1.5/2.0 using integer quarter units and a hard 2.0x ceiling. Auto consumes only injected logical-delivery samples and uses deterministic fast-up/slow-down hysteresis. A common prospective budget ledger accounts source bytes and protection spend across duplicate, reinjection and future FEC categories without retroactively granting budget after an Auto upshift. Local vet, normal/race tests, protocol fuzz, Linux/386, Linux/mipsle and Windows/amd64 RBC cross-builds, handoff verification and continuity tests passed. M7 was also fully reconciled before this checkpoint.
continuation_cursor.current_task: M9-001: build a deterministic weak-network protection micro-harness that consumes the M8 RBC budget and compares reinjection/duplicate allocation against a minimal XOR-repair prototype under identical source bytes and fault schedules.
continuation_cursor.why_now: The project now has bounded per-lane flight, a dedicated rescue path, logical reinjection and an explicit 1.0x..2.0x protection budget. FEC should be admitted only if it buys measurable logical-delivery latency under the same byte budget rather than adding complexity by assumption.
continuation_cursor.done_when: A pure-Go deterministic harness can replay fixed stall/burst/reorder schedules for the same logical chunks, enforce identical RBC protection entitlement for each strategy, report logical completion step/latency proxy plus protection bytes, compare reinjection-only, duplicate and minimal XOR-repair variants at 1.5x and 2.0x, and either demonstrate a repeatable repair advantage or record a clear no-admit result. No public wire-format, Xray/REALITY, TUN or platform-specific changes.
continuation_cursor.next_atomic_action: M9-001: add an internal deterministic protection simulator/harness around RBC Budget and logical chunk identities; implement reinjection-only and duplicate baselines plus the smallest XOR-repair prototype as an experiment, then run fixed single-stall and burst-loss schedules at 1.5x/2.0x.
